subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add a separate `registerControlUiEntryPoint` app-nav/launch-token API, or should this PR be rebased to extend the existing descriptor-based plugin tab seam?
rationale: The PR changes the public Plugin SDK, Gateway RPC surface, and browser auth/sandbox boundary, and automation cannot safely choose the permanent API shape or acceptable top-level plugin page security model.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Descriptor Tabs
options.body: Rebase and implement any missing scoped-launch behavior through `registerControlUiDescriptor({ surface: "tab", path })`, keeping plugin UI in the host-owned opaque iframe.

options.title: Approve A Separate Entry API
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint` only after maintainer and secops review explicitly accept the duplicate SDK seam and top-level launch model.

options.title: Pause For RFC Resolution
options.body: Close or pause this PR and resolve the broader plugin UI direction in the open Control UI plugin contribution RFCs first.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Existing Descriptor Tabs
recommendation.body: Rebase and implement any missing scoped-launch behavior through `registerControlUiDescriptor({ surface: "tab", path })`, keeping plugin UI in the host-owned opaque iframe.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently refactored the current plugin/UI descriptor implementation on main and are the clearest current-code routing point for the API-shape decision.
